item.title: How Ohio State Athletic Director Ross Bjork Would Change the College Football Calendar
item.description: You can count Ohio State athletic director Ross Bjork among the many people involved in college football who believe the sport’s calendar needs to change. Thanks to the new 15-day January transfer portal window that was implemented for college football this year, the entirety of this year’s transfer portal window took place while the College Football Playoff was still ongoing. item.description: Ohio State will have three new kickers on its 2026 roster. item.title: Columbus Aviators Sign Aidan Sayin, Older Brother of Ohio State Quarterback Julian Sayin
item.description: There are now two Sayins playing quarterback in Columbus. Aidan Sayin, the older brother of Ohio State quarterback Julian Sayin, signed with the UFL’s Columbus Aviators on Tuesday. Sayin is a former quarterback at the University of Pennsylvania, where he started 31 games from 2021-24 and completed a school-record 719 passes on 1,151 attempts (62.5%) for 7,177 yards with 45 touchdowns and 31 interceptions.
